blocks.text: HOCl aur OCl⁻ dono asar-daar disinfectants hain, lekin HOCl zyada asar-daar hai kyun ke is par koi charge nahi (neutral hai). Neutral hone ki wajah se HOCl micro-organisms (khurdbeeni jaandaar) ki cell walls mein aasani se dakhil ho jata hai. HOCl aur OCl⁻ cell ke zaroori hisson, jaise proteins aur lipids (charbi wale maadde), ko oxidize kar dete hain; is se cell ka kaam bigar jata hai aur cell mar jata hai. HOCl aur OCl⁻ un enzymes ko bhi oxidize kar ke bekaar (inactivate) kar dete hain jo bacteria ke zinda rehne aur barhne (replication) ke liye zaroori hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: HOCl aur OCl⁻ nucleic acids (DNA aur RNA) ko bhi oxidize kar sakte hain; is tarah bacteria apni nasal nahi barha pate (replicate nahi kar pate) aur un ke zaroori cell ke kaam ruk jate hain.
